description: This Java class handles delete commands for entity datatable checks within the Fineract project. It implements a command handler interface, is annotated as a service, and delegates the delete operation to a service layer.

classes.name: DeleteEntityDatatableChecksCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles delete commands for entity datatable checks by implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegating the delete operation to the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the deleteCheck method on the write platform service, passing the entity ID extracted from the command.
